First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace isn't posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you're new when you arrive.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Orem Bicycle Coalition Monthly Ride group ride

Orem Bicycle Coalition Monthly Ride is a social group ride in Orem, UT. It rolls second Wednesday of the month at 5:30 pm from Mad Dog Cycles.

A monthly community ride from the Mad Dog Cycles shop in Orem, run by the local bike advocacy group. Listed on the shop's local rides page; updates go out on the coalition's Facebook page.
